August 1, 2005

I've finally
finished
Heroes' Altar. I
think this will be
my last game: I'm
about to start my
second year of
senior high, and the
huge study load
makes it really hard
to throw myself into
making games
anymore.
This game wasn't
made by me alone.
Lots of people
helped me along the
way; I won't thank
them one by one
here.
Finally, have fun
playing, and read
the Healthy Gaming
Advice!

Caizi Studio
